caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, light beige or off-white background with some scattered brownish stains. The object appears to be a hand mirror with a dark, bronze or brownish handle and frame. The frame is pointed at the top, resembling a gothic or arched window. Within the reflective surface of the mirror, there is a dark, near-monochrome depiction of a human bust, facing forward, with vague facial features and a collared garment. The mirror and its handle are rendered with shading that gives a three-dimensional appearance. The composition is minimal, with the mirror and its reflection occupying a small portion of the image space, leaving large empty margins around it. The word "Violet" is written in small letters beneath the object.
title: Trivet
